messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 decode latency spike detected on pool=dedicated-eu-west-1, model=redwood-large-3 (rolling window 5m). SLO breach triggered. Pager: eng-sre.

Alex Kim: seeing huge tail on streaming responses, a lot of stalled chunks. p95 up ~2.5x, p99 ~4x. Some requests timeout at client side.

Mira Patel: dashboard link: https://console.redwood.internal/dashboards/pool/dedicated-eu-west-1/latency (embedding for on-call). Confirming: p95 380ms -> 1100ms, p99 1.2s -> 4.8s, streaming stalls visible in trace spans.

Darren Lu: runtime note: we rolled TRT8 image tagged v8.1.3 to that pool last night as part of the kernel experiment. Also enabled new matrix-mul kernel and turned on the flash-attn plugin via COMPILE_FLAGS. Might be related.

Lina Gomez: customer impact snapshot: 3 paid customers saw increased 5xx/retries in last 30m (cust-a, cust-d, cust-e). Top impacted route: /v1/stream/generate-chat. On-call runbook says to check model variants and fallback routing.

Alex Kim: streaming encoder/decoder stalls correlate with kernel decode spans that show long memcpy+wait on CUDA stream. traces: ```trace_id: 0x7f12 decode_span { kernel: matmul_cuda_v2, duration: 2.3s }```

Ashley SRE: taking incident lead. Quick mitigation steps: 1) disable flash-attn plugin via env USE_FLASHATTN=false on the pool 2) if no improvement, rollback TRT image to v8.1.1 3) enable routing fallback to smaller-latency model redwood-medium-2 for streaming. I'll coordinate.

Darren Lu: patch commands ready: ```bash
# disable flashattn env on pool
kubectl set env deploy/dedicated-runtime -n redwood POOL=dedicated-eu-west-1 USE_FLASHATTN=false
# rollback image if needed
kubectl set image deploy/dedicated-runtime redwood/runtime=redwood/runtime:v8.1.1 -n redwood
```

Mira Patel: rolling the env var now to canaries (5% traffic). Will monitor p95/p99 and streaming error rate. Canary done at t+6m.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout of USE_FLASHATTN=false to dedicated-eu-west-1 completed (5% traffic). Healthchecks: OK.

Mira Patel: Canary shows p95 back to ~420ms, p99 down to ~1.1s. Streaming stalls reduced in canaries. No customer-facing errors in canary hosts.

Ashley SRE: good. Promote to global rollout. Execute rollback if not improved after 10m.

Alex Kim: global rollout started. applying to remaining pods.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: global rollout of USE_FLASHATTN=false completed.

Mira Patel: monitoring: p95 across pool stabilized to ~390ms (near normal). p99 reduced to ~620ms but still elevated vs baseline; streaming stalls significantly reduced. Error rate back to baseline.

Darren Lu: still see a small subset of pods with higher decode latency — looks like some pods built with a different compiler flags set (COMPILE_FLAGS="-O3 -mtrt-optimized"). I suspect the compile path difference + flash-attn combination amplified the tail.

Ashley SRE: mitigation summary for handoff: flash-attn disabled globally at 2214124012, primary mitigation successful. Still open: investigate mixed compile flags across pool and identify pods built from stale build image. Action items: (1) run image inventory across nodes, (2) force redeploy of affected nodes with consistent build, (3) schedule safe rollout of TRT8 kernel with A/B feature gating.

Lina Gomez: customer comms draft: "We've mitigated a latency regression impacting streaming on dedicated-eu-west-1 by disabling a new low-level kernel optimization and rolling back configuration. If you saw an increase in latency between 14:10–15:05 UTC, this was the cause; the team has mitigated and is doing a root cause analysis." Would like a sign-off.

Ashley SRE: sign-off. I'll own postmortem. Prioritized RCA: compile flags + TRT8 kernel interaction.

Darren Lu: quick commands for inventory: ```bash
# list images on nodes in pool
for n in $(kubectl get nodes -l pool=dedicated-eu-west-1 -o name); do ssh $n "docker images | grep runtime"; done
# taint one bad node and cordon
kubectl cordon <node>
kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

Alex Kim: will follow up with trace samples and a small reproducer on a dev GPU. Putting the thread into: incident-closed (mitigated -> flash-attn disable).

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> mitigation="flash-attn disabled" lead="Ashley SRE" status="monitoring".

Ashley SRE: next steps captured in ticket INF-4312. Assigning to Darren for build consistency, Mira for monitoring dashboards, Alex for trace reproduction. Will do a scheduled canary deploy of tuned TRT8 kernels next week with telemetry gates.

ops-bot: reminder: escalation window still open until 2214127456.

Alex Kim: thanks everyone. I'll drop final trace bundle into INF-4312 and attach the reproducer.

Mira Patel: closing slack handoff, will ping if regressions reappear. :thumbsup:
